senses.en: to work for someone, or to give food

ex.en: They serve lunch from eleven to one.
ex.zh: 他们十一点到一点供应午餐。

ex.en: Libraries that serve small towns often share one librarian among several buildings.
ex.zh: 服务小城镇的图书馆，常常是几栋楼共用一位馆员。

tip: serve 后直接接人或食物。It serves you right 表示活该，语气重。

senses.en: millimetre

ex.en: The line is 5 mm wide.
ex.zh: 这条线宽 5 毫米。

ex.en: A map that uses mm without a scale still leaves the reader guessing.
ex.zh: 不用比例尺却用毫米的地图，仍然让读者猜。

tip: mm 是 millimetre 的缩写。数字和 mm 之间通常留空格。

senses.en: a person who knows a lot about one subject

ex.en: The specialist checked the clock.
ex.zh: 专家检查了钟。

ex.en: A specialist who names no source is harder to trust.
ex.zh: 不写来源的专家更难信任。

tip: special 已在本库。

senses.en: knowledge from careful study and experiment

ex.en: Science class is in the lab today.
ex.zh: 今天的科学课在实验室。

ex.en: Science can measure dirty air, but a city still has to decide what to do about it.
ex.zh: 科学可以测量脏空气，但城市仍要决定对此做什么。

tip: science 作学科通常不可数。

senses.en: to press a mouse or a button
a short sound or one press

ex.en: Click the title to open the article.
ex.zh: 点击标题打开文章。

ex.en: A design that needs three clicks to find the nurse's number wastes time in a real emergency.
ex.zh: 要点击三次才能找到校医电话的设计，会在真正的紧急情况里浪费时间。

tip: click 也可作名词，指咔哒声或一次点击。

senses.en: soft white frozen water
to fall as snow

ex.en: Snow closed the path for a day.
ex.zh: 雪把小路封了一天。

ex.en: A town that plans for snow keeps the school open when the main road is still white.
ex.zh: 为雪做准备的城镇，在大路还是白的时候也能让学校开门。

tip: snow 作名词通常不可数。作动词：It snows。

senses.en: to fail to remember

ex.en: Do not forget to write the date.
ex.zh: 别忘了写日期。

ex.en: Towns forget a flood until the same street fills again.
ex.zh: 城镇会忘记洪水，直到同一条街再次积水。

tip: forget to do 是忘了要做；forget doing 是忘了做过。

senses.en: level, without bumps
a set of rooms for living in, on one floor

ex.en: The pitch is flat and dry.
ex.zh: 场地又平又干。

ex.en: A flat battery in the school bus is a morning problem, not a surprise at the gate.
ex.zh: 校车电池没电是早晨就要处理的问题，不该到门口才发现。

tip: 英式 flat 作名词是公寓，美式常用 apartment。

senses.en: the smallest amount or degree
the smallest in amount

ex.en: This is the least difficult of the three questions.
ex.zh: 这是三道题里最不难的。

ex.en: The least expensive food is not always the one that keeps students awake through the afternoon.
ex.zh: 最便宜的食物不一定能让学生整个下午保持清醒。

tip: at least 表示至少；not in the least 表示一点也不。

senses.en: a prize given for achievement
to give a prize or a sum officially

ex.en: She won an award for the science poster.
ex.zh: 她的科学海报得了奖。

ex.en: An award for perfect attendance can hide the student who was ill and still caught up.
ex.zh: 全勤奖可能掩盖那个生过病却仍然补上进度的学生。

col: award sb sth｜授予某人某物
tip: award 作动词是“授予”。不要和 reward（酬谢）搞混。

senses.en: belonging to a whole country

ex.en: The national museum is free on Wednesdays.
ex.zh: 国家博物馆周三免费。

ex.en: A national exam should not ignore students whose schools lack labs and libraries.
ex.zh: 一场全国性考试不该忽略那些学校缺少实验室和图书馆的学生。

tip: national 是形容词；国家用 nation 或 country。

senses.en: not ordinary

ex.en: Today is a special day for our school.
ex.zh: 今天对我们学校是特别的一天。

ex.en: A special bus for students works only if it arrives before the first lesson, not after.
ex.zh: 学生专车只有在第一节课前到达才有用，而不是课后。

tip: specially 强调专门地；especially 强调尤其。

senses.en: of a city

ex.en: Urban schools share one crowded bus stop.
ex.zh: 城市学校共用一个拥挤的公交站。

ex.en: Urban growth that ignores the river will meet the water in the streets.
ex.zh: 不顾河流的城市扩张，会在街上遇见那河水。

tip: urban 的反义是 rural。不要和 suburb（郊区）混淆。

senses.en: without war or violence, or calm

ex.en: The hall was peaceful after the bell.
ex.zh: 铃响之后礼堂很平静。

ex.en: A peaceful protest still needs a clear request.
ex.zh: 和平的诉求仍然需要一个清楚的要求。

tip: peace 已在本库。

senses.en: a living thing that grows in soil or water
to put seeds or trees in the ground

ex.en: Each class looks after one plant in the hallway.
ex.zh: 每个班在走廊里照料一盆植物。

ex.en: Cities that plant trees along school roads give children shade on the walk home.
ex.zh: 在上学的路边种树的城市，让孩子放学路上有树荫。

tip: plant 作动词是种植。power plant 是发电厂，不是植物。

senses.en: to arrive at, or to touch by stretching
the distance one can stretch

ex.en: We reached the museum before it closed.
ex.zh: 我们在闭馆前到达了博物馆。

ex.en: A warning that does not reach homes without a phone signal arrives too late.
ex.zh: 到不了没有手机信号的家庭的警报，来得太晚。

tip: reach 是及物动词，后面直接接地点，不加 to。

senses.en: to invite someone to compete or try hard
Question whether something is true, fair, or acceptable.
Invite someone to compete or test their abilities.

ex.en: This puzzle will challenge your mind.
ex.zh: 这道谜题会挑战你的思维。

ex.en: Providing affordable housing remains a major challenge for cities experiencing rapid population growth and rising land prices.
ex.zh: 对于人口快速增长、地价不断上涨的城市而言，提供可负担住房仍是一项重大挑战。

col: meet a challenge｜成功应对挑战
challenge someone to a contest｜向某人发起比赛挑战
tip: challenge作动词可直接接观点，表示质疑。

senses.en: newspapers, television, and the internet as a group

ex.en: Social media spread the news within an hour.
ex.zh: 社交媒体在一小时内传播了这条消息。

ex.en: The media can help a town prepare for a flood, or they can only arrive to film the damage.
ex.zh: 媒体可以帮助一个城镇为洪水做准备，也可以只在事后前来拍摄损失。

tip: media 是 medium 的复数，谓语常用复数。

senses.en: the flesh of animals used as food

ex.en: Some students do not eat meat.
ex.zh: 有些学生不吃肉。

ex.en: A menu that hides meat in the sauce is not a choice for those students.
ex.zh: 把肉藏在酱里的菜单，对那些学生来说不是选择。

tip: meat 通常不可数。鱼有时不叫 meat。

senses.en: the part of the body between the head and the shoulders

ex.en: She wore a scarf around her neck.
ex.zh: 她脖子上围着围巾。

ex.en: Pain in the neck after a long exam is a reason to stand up, not to ignore it.
ex.zh: 长时间考试后脖子疼，是站起来的理由，不是置之不理。

tip: a pain in the neck 也可比喻讨厌的人或事，语气不礼貌。

senses.en: a soft piece of paper, or a group of cells

ex.en: Take a tissue for the lab.
ex.zh: 带一张纸巾去实验室。

ex.en: The word tissue in a health lesson means body tissue, not only paper.
ex.zh: 健康课里的 tissue 指身体组织，而不只是纸。

col: a box of tissues｜一盒纸巾
tip: 纸巾常用复数 tissues。本条不写实验步骤。

senses.en: something said or written clearly

ex.en: The school made a short statement.
ex.zh: 学校发表了一则简短声明。

ex.en: A public statement about a flood should say which roads are closed.
ex.zh: 关于洪水的公开声明应该说明哪些路封闭了。

tip: statement 是可数名词。

senses.en: a common green plant, or a lawn

ex.en: The grass is wet.
ex.zh: 草地是湿的。

ex.en: Grass along the path needs less water than a lawn that must stay perfect.
ex.zh: 路边的草比必须保持完美的草坪更省水。

col: a blade of grass｜一片草叶
tip: grass 通常不可数。

senses.en: to help someone learn

ex.en: She will teach us the song.
ex.zh: 她将教我们这首歌。

ex.en: Schools teach more than the exam list when they show how to check a source.
ex.zh: 当学校展示如何核对来源时，它们教的就不只是考试清单。

tip: teach 的过去式和过去分词是 taught。teacher 已在本库。表里这一行的音标是 tea，本库不用。

senses.en: to hold and move something

ex.en: Can you carry this box to the lab?
ex.zh: 你能把这个箱子搬到实验室吗？

ex.en: Buses that cannot carry wheelchairs leave some students outside the trip they helped to plan.
ex.zh: 不能运送轮椅的公交，会把一些学生留在他们参与策划的出行之外。

tip: carry 强调随身带着走。搬重物也可用 carry。

senses.en: the threads that grow on the head

ex.en: Tie your hair back in the lab.
ex.zh: 在实验室里把头发扎起来。

ex.en: Hair colour tells you nothing about whether a student can solve the problem.
ex.zh: 头发的颜色说明不了一个学生能否解出这道题。

tip: hair 通常不可数。一根头发用 a hair。

senses.en: of the colour of grass
the colour green

ex.en: The green bike is mine.
ex.zh: 那辆绿色自行车是我的。

ex.en: Green space near a school gives children somewhere to play that is not a car park.
ex.zh: 学校附近的绿地给孩子一个玩耍的地方，而不是停车场。

tip: green 也可表示环保的：green energy。

senses.en: to name, phone, or shout to someone
a phone conversation or a shout

ex.en: We call our teacher Mr. Chen.
ex.zh: 我们称呼老师为陈老师。

ex.en: Parents who call the school only after a problem appears miss the chance to help earlier.
ex.zh: 只在问题出现后才给学校打电话的家长，错过了更早帮忙的机会。

col: give sb a call｜给某人打电话
tip: call sb sth 表示把某人称作……，中间不加 as。

senses.en: a food made from milk

ex.en: The sandwich has cheese in it.
ex.zh: 三明治里有奶酪。

ex.en: Cheese left out of the fridge is a small thing that can close a canteen for a day.
ex.zh: 没放进冰箱的奶酪是小事，却可以让食堂停一天。

col: a piece of cheese｜一块奶酪
tip: cheese 作物质名词通常不可数。a cheese 可指一种或一块。

senses.en: the smallest amount allowed or possible
the smallest that is allowed

ex.en: The minimum age for the trip is twelve.
ex.zh: 这次出行的最低年龄是十二岁。

ex.en: A minimum of sleep is not a luxury if the first lesson starts at seven.
ex.zh: 如果第一节课七点开始，最低限度的睡眠就不是奢侈。

tip: minimum 也可作形容词：the minimum score。反义是 maximum。

senses.en: a metal container for cooking

ex.en: The pan is still hot.
ex.zh: 平底锅还烫。

ex.en: A pan without a cover in the canteen spills more than it saves.
ex.zh: 食堂里没有盖的锅洒出来的比省下的多。

tip: pan 可数。

senses.en: measuring a great length or time
to want something very much

ex.en: It was a long walk from the station.
ex.zh: 从车站走过来要很久。

ex.en: A long commute can take away the evening hours that students need for sleep and reading.
ex.zh: 漫长的通勤会占去学生需要用于睡觉和阅读的晚上时间。

tip: how long 询问时间或长度。long 作动词是“渴望”。

senses.en: a movement of the foot, or one stage of a process
to move the foot

ex.en: The first step is to read the question.
ex.zh: 第一步是读题。

ex.en: The next step after a flood warning is a lit path to higher ground, not only a message.
ex.zh: 洪水警报之后的下一步是一条有灯的通往高地的路，而不只是一条信息。

tip: step 作动词是“迈步”。

senses.en: a part of a bird or plane used for flying

ex.en: The bird hurt one wing.
ex.zh: 这只鸟伤了一只翅膀。

ex.en: The east wing of the school is colder because that wall faces the wind.
ex.zh: 教学楼东翼更冷，因为那面墙迎着风。

tip: 建筑的侧翼也叫 wing。

senses.en: an occasion when people come together

ex.en: The meeting starts at two.
ex.zh: 会议两点开始。

ex.en: A public meeting about a new road should happen before the machines arrive.
ex.zh: 关于新路的公开会议应该在机器到来之前举行。

tip: meeting 是可数名词。

senses.en: twice as much, or made of two parts
to become twice as much

ex.en: We need a double check of the names.
ex.zh: 我们需要把名字再核对一遍。

ex.en: A double fare after dark makes the night bus too costly for the workers who need it most.
ex.zh: 天黑后的双倍票价，让最需要夜班公交的工人负担不起。

tip: double 作动词是“加倍”。

senses.en: a human-made waterway

ex.en: The path follows the canal.
ex.zh: 这条路沿着运河走。

ex.en: A canal without a rail is not a safe walk to school.
ex.zh: 没有栏杆的运河不是安全的上学路。

tip: canal 可数。

senses.en: a place for money, or the side of a river

ex.en: The bank is next to the post office.
ex.zh: 银行在邮局旁边。

ex.en: Houses on the bank of a river are cheap until the water reaches the door.
ex.zh: 河边的房子在水漫到门口之前显得便宜。

tip: bank 的两个常见义是银行和岸，要看搭配。

senses.en: animals and plants living in natural conditions

ex.en: The park protects wildlife.
ex.zh: 这个公园保护野生动物。

ex.en: Wildlife near a school needs a path that is not a road.
ex.zh: 学校附近的野生动物需要一条不是马路的小路。

tip: wildlife 通常不可数。

senses.en: the front of the body between the neck and the stomach, or a large box

ex.en: The pain is in his chest, so call the clinic.
ex.zh: 他胸口疼，所以去叫医务室。

ex.en: A chest of old maps can teach a town where the river used to run.
ex.zh: 一箱旧地图能告诉一座城镇河曾经从哪里流过。

tip: 胸口和箱子是同一个词，要看语境。胸口疼应当告诉成年人或医务室。

senses.en: one of two children born at the same time

ex.en: Her twin sits in the next class.
ex.zh: 她的双胞胎兄弟姐妹坐在隔壁班。

ex.en: A form should leave space for a twin, not assume one child.
ex.zh: 表格应当给双胞胎留出位置，而不假定只有一个孩子。

tip: twin 可数。表里这一行的音标是 twist，本库不用。

senses.en: almost not

ex.en: I can hardly hear the bell from here.
ex.zh: 我在这里几乎听不见铃。

ex.en: A rule that students can hardly read is not a rule they can follow.
ex.zh: 学生几乎读不懂的规定，不是他们能遵守的规定。

tip: hardly 已含否定，不要再加 not。它放在实义动词前、助动词后。不要和 hard（努力地）混淆。

senses.en: from one side to the other, or by means of

ex.en: We walked through the market on the way home.
ex.zh: 我们回家时穿过了市场。

ex.en: Students learn more through explaining an idea than through reading the same note again.
ex.zh: 学生通过讲解一个想法学到的，往往多于把同一条笔记再读一遍。

tip: through 强调从内部穿过；across 强调从表面一边到另一边。

senses.en: the state of being safe

ex.en: Road safety is part of the first lesson.
ex.zh: 交通安全是第一课的一部分。

ex.en: Safety on the walk home depends on lights and pavements, not only on advice.
ex.zh: 回家路上的安全取决于灯和人行道，而不只是劝告。

tip: safety 是名词，不可数。

senses.en: a senior member of a government

ex.en: The education minister visited the school.
ex.zh: 教育部长参观了这所学校。

ex.en: A minister who never rides the bus may not see why the last service matters.
ex.zh: 从不坐公交的部长，可能看不到为什么末班车重要。

tip: minister 也可指牧师，考纲里更常见的是政府部长。

senses.en: the activity of using one's mind

ex.en: Critical thinking is part of the history course.
ex.zh: 批判性思考是历史课的一部分。

ex.en: Quick thinking on social media is not the same as careful thinking about a source.
ex.zh: 社交媒体上的快速思考，不等于对来源的仔细思考。

tip: thinking 是 think 的 -ing，也可作名词。

senses.en: legally acceptable, or based on good reason

ex.en: The ticket is valid until Friday.
ex.zh: 这张票周五前有效。

ex.en: A valid reason for a late bus is a written fault, not a guess.
ex.zh: 晚班车的合理理由是写下来的故障，不是猜测。

tip: valid 可指证件有效，也可指理由站得住。

senses.en: an idea for what to do
to decide what to do

ex.en: Our plan is to finish the poster today.
ex.zh: 我们的计划是今天完成海报。

ex.en: A flood plan that exists only on paper will fail the first night the river rises.
ex.zh: 只存在于纸上的防汛计划，会在河水上涨的第一个夜里失败。

tip: plan 作动词后接 to do，不接 doing。

senses.en: difficulty or worry
to make someone worried or to disturb them

ex.en: We had trouble finding the right room.
ex.zh: 我们费了劲才找到那间教室。

ex.en: Asking for help early can keep a small trouble from becoming a missed exam.
ex.zh: 早点求助，可以避免一个小麻烦变成一场错过的考试。

col: have trouble doing｜做某事有困难
tip: have trouble doing 不说 have trouble to do。

senses.en: a public show of objects

ex.en: The exhibition is free on Sunday.
ex.zh: 展览周日免费。

ex.en: An exhibition that closes before the last bus has already chosen its visitors.
ex.zh: 在末班车之前就关门的展览，其实已经选定了观众。

tip: exhibition 可数。

senses.en: a problem
A problem that makes progress or success harder.

ex.en: She overcame great difficulty to succeed.
ex.zh: 她克服巨大困难获得成功。

ex.en: Students with limited internet access may have difficulty completing assignments that require extensive online research.
ex.zh: 网络使用受限的学生可能难以完成需要大量网上研究的作业。

col: have difficulty doing something｜做某事有困难
tip: 用have difficulty doing，不用difficulty to do。

senses.en: the gas from boiling water
to cook with steam, or to give off steam

ex.en: Steam rose from the pot.
ex.zh: 蒸汽从锅里升起。

ex.en: Steam in a closed kitchen is a reason to open a window.
ex.zh: 关着的厨房里的蒸汽，是打开窗户的理由。

tip: steam 通常不可数。作动词是蒸或冒热气。

senses.en: not in danger

ex.en: Is the bridge safe after the rain?
ex.zh: 雨后这座桥安全吗？

ex.en: A street is not safe for children if cars park on the only pavement.
ex.zh: 如果汽车停在唯一的人行道上，这条街对孩子就不安全。

tip: safe 是形容词；safety 是名词。

senses.en: causing laughter, or strange

ex.en: The story was funny, and we still learned the word.
ex.zh: 故事很滑稽，我们仍然学会了那个词。

ex.en: It is funny that a town boasts of a new mall while its oldest school still leaks.
ex.zh: 一座城镇吹嘘新商场，而最老的学校仍在漏雨，这很奇怪。

tip: funny 是“滑稽的”或“奇怪的”；fun 是名词“乐趣”。

senses.en: the way someone acts; British spelling

ex.en: The behaviour in the hall was calm.
ex.zh: 礼堂里的行为很平静。

ex.en: Fair rules look at behaviour, not at who arrived in a quiet car.
ex.zh: 公平的规定看行为，而不是看谁坐着安静的车来的。

tip: behaviour 是英式，behavior 是美式，已在本库。两条都保留。通常不可数。

senses.en: happening most often

ex.en: She took the usual bus.
ex.zh: 她坐了平时那班车。

ex.en: The usual route fails on the day the bridge closes, so the notice must say the other way.
ex.zh: 桥关闭的那天平时的路线走不通，所以通知必须写出另一条路。

tip: as usual 表示和往常一样。usually 是副词。

senses.en: a planned way of doing something

ex.en: This method makes the experiment clearer.
ex.zh: 这个方法让实验更清楚。

ex.en: A teaching method that works in a small class may fail when forty students share one room.
ex.zh: 小班有效的教学方法，在四十个学生共用一间教室时可能失败。

tip: method 后接 of doing 或 for doing。

senses.en: to give money for something
money received for work

ex.en: I paid for the tickets online.
ex.zh: 我在网上付了票钱。

ex.en: Families who pay a large share of their income for rent have less left for books and clinics.
ex.zh: 把收入的很大一部分用来付房租的家庭，留给书和看病的钱就更少。

tip: pay 的过去式和过去分词是 paid。人作主语：sb pays for sth。

senses.en: an open public place in a town
having four equal sides, or multiplied by itself

ex.en: We met in the square outside the museum.
ex.zh: 我们在博物馆外的广场见面。

ex.en: A town square that bans bikes may feel tidy and still be harder for students to reach.
ex.zh: 禁止自行车的城镇广场也许看起来整齐，学生却更难到达。

tip: square 作形容词是方形的，也可指数学上的平方。

senses.en: having lived long, or not new

ex.en: This is an old map, but the river is the same.
ex.zh: 这是一张旧地图，但那条河还是一样的。

ex.en: Old buildings can teach a city what to keep when everything else is being rebuilt.
ex.zh: 当其他一切都在重建时，老建筑可以告诉一座城市该保留什么。

tip: 表示年龄用数字加 years old。兄姐用 elder 或 older 都可以。

senses.en: the lowest part

ex.en: The key is at the bottom of the bag.
ex.zh: 钥匙在包的底部。

ex.en: Notes at the bottom of a chart often explain the number that the headline left out.
ex.zh: 图表底部的注释，常常解释标题没写的那个数字。

tip: bottom 是最下面。from the bottom of one's heart 表示衷心。

senses.en: something done wrongly
to be wrong about something

ex.en: I made a mistake in the date.
ex.zh: 我把日期写错了。

ex.en: A mistake in the bus time should be corrected before parents leave work to meet it.
ex.zh: 公交时间的错误应当在家长下班来接之前改掉。

tip: by mistake 表示无意中做错。过去式 mistook，过去分词 mistaken。

senses.en: to say or do again

ex.en: Please repeat the time.
ex.zh: 请把时间再说一遍。

ex.en: Teachers repeat a warning when the first one was on a poster nobody could see.
ex.zh: 当第一次警告写在没人看得见的海报上时，老师会再讲一遍。

tip: repeat 后直接接内容，不说 repeat again 除非强调又一次。

senses.en: to greet someone in a friendly way
gladly received
a friendly greeting

ex.en: We welcome new students on the first day.
ex.zh: 我们在第一天欢迎新生。

ex.en: A town should welcome questions about a new road before the machines arrive.
ex.zh: 在机器到来之前，城镇应该欢迎关于新路的提问。

tip: welcome 作形容词是“受欢迎的”：You are welcome。

senses.en: to answer or react

ex.en: Please respond to the e-mail today.
ex.zh: 请今天回复这封电子邮件。

ex.en: Schools should respond to a broken step before they respond to a complaint about paint.
ex.zh: 学校应当先回应坏掉的台阶，再回应关于油漆的投诉。

tip: respond to something。表里这一行的音标是 respect，本库不用。

senses.en: a shared decision, or the state of agreeing

ex.en: The two classes reached an agreement about the hall.
ex.zh: 两个班就礼堂的使用达成了协议。

ex.en: An agreement on water use fails if nobody writes down who may pump on a dry day.
ex.zh: 如果没人写下干旱日谁可以抽水，用水协议就会失败。

tip: 达成协议用 reach 或 come to an agreement。

senses.en: a period of seven days

ex.en: We have a test next week.
ex.zh: 我们下周有一次测验。

ex.en: A four-day school week may cut costs, but it can also lengthen each remaining day beyond what children can manage.
ex.zh: 每周上四天课也许能省钱，但也可能把剩下的每天拉长到孩子承受不了。

tip: next week 前不加 the。

senses.en: a set of connected people, computers, or routes

ex.en: The bus network does not reach our village.
ex.zh: 公交网络到不了我们村。

ex.en: A phone network that fails in a storm leaves the people who need a warning without one.
ex.zh: 在风暴中失灵的电话网络，会让最需要警报的人收不到警报。

tip: network 可指计算机网络，也可指交通或人际网络。

senses.en: to have inside
to prevent something from spreading or becoming stronger

ex.en: This box may contain old letters.
ex.zh: 这个盒子里可能装有旧信。

ex.en: Processed foods often contain large amounts of salt, which can contribute to serious health problems.
ex.zh: 加工食品往往含有大量盐分，可能导致严重的健康问题。

tip: 及物动词，直接接宾语；表示“含有”时通常不用进行时。

senses.en: a sudden feeling of fear
to feel sudden fear

ex.en: There was no need to panic.
ex.zh: 没有必要惊慌。

ex.en: A clear alarm prevents panic better than a shout.
ex.zh: 清楚的警报比一声喊叫更能避免惊慌。

tip: panic 作动词是惊慌。过去式 panicked。本条不写制造恐慌的做法。

senses.en: difficult, or strong and not easily broken

ex.en: The first chapter is tough, but it gets clearer.
ex.zh: 第一章很难，但后面会清楚些。

ex.en: A tough timetable is fairer when every class, not only the top set, can use the lab.
ex.zh: 艰难的课表若让每个班而不只是尖子班都能用实验室，就更公平。

tip: tough 可形容任务难，也可形容人或材料结实。表里音标是 totally，本库不用。

senses.en: very bad or strict

ex.en: The storm caused severe damage.
ex.zh: 暴风雨造成了严重损失。

ex.en: Severe rules without an explanation teach fear more than safety.
ex.zh: 没有解释的严厉规定，教给人们的是害怕多于安全。

tip: severe 比 serious 语气更强。

senses.en: before noon

ex.en: The reading room opens at 7 a.m.
ex.zh: 阅览室早上七点开门。

ex.en: Starting lessons at 7 a.m. may suit adults, but many teenagers are still at their sleepiest then.
ex.zh: 早上七点上课也许适合成年人，但许多青少年那时仍处于最困的时候。

tip: a.m. 表示午夜到中午；书写时数字与 a.m. 之间留空格。

senses.en: an informal hello

ex.en: She said hi to the new student.
ex.zh: 她向新同学说了声嗨。

ex.en: A friendly hi at the gate does not replace a safe road, but it can make the first day easier.
ex.zh: 门口一声友好的嗨替代不了安全的路，但能让第一天容易些。

tip: hi 比 hello 更随意，正式场合少用。

senses.en: a set of beliefs in a god or gods

ex.en: The class studies religion as history, not as a test of faith.
ex.zh: 这个班把宗教当历史来学，而不是信仰测验。

ex.en: A public school can explain a religion without telling students to join it.
ex.zh: 公立学校可以讲解一种宗教，而不要求学生加入。

tip: 形容词 religious 已在本库。

senses.en: a talk in which people share opinions

ex.en: The discussion lasted twenty minutes.
ex.zh: 讨论持续了二十分钟。

ex.en: A discussion about the bus route should include the students who miss it.
ex.zh: 关于公交路线的讨论应当包括那些赶不上车的学生。

tip: 动词是 discuss，已在本库。discuss 后不加 about，名词 discussion 后常用 about 或 of。

senses.en: a marriage ceremony

ex.en: The wedding is in the town hall.
ex.zh: 婚礼在市政厅举行。

ex.en: A school should not assume every family celebrates a wedding in the same way.
ex.zh: 学校不应当假定每个家庭都以同样的方式庆祝婚礼。

tip: wedding 是仪式。婚姻关系用 marriage。

senses.en: a thin string of cotton or similar material
to put thread through

ex.en: The button needs a stronger thread.
ex.zh: 这颗扣子需要更结实的线。

ex.en: A thread of the story is the late bus, not the joke.
ex.zh: 故事的一条线索是晚班车，不是那个笑话。

tip: thread 也可比喻线索。作动词是穿线。

senses.en: the act of finding something, or the thing found

ex.en: The discovery is explained in the last chapter.
ex.zh: 这个发现在最后一章说明。

ex.en: A discovery in the lab is useful only when the notes can be read by the next class.
ex.zh: 实验室里的发现，只有在下一班能读懂笔记时才有用。

tip: 动词 discover 已在本库。discovery 可数。

senses.en: the red liquid in the body

ex.en: The nurse stopped the blood with a clean cloth.
ex.zh: 护士用干净的布止住了血。

ex.en: Loss of blood is one reason a village clinic must be close, not an hour away.
ex.zh: 失血是乡村诊所必须在近处、而不是一小时之外的原因之一。

tip: blood 不可数。

senses.en: a series of actions
to treat or deal with something in stages

ex.en: Learning a word is a slow process.
ex.zh: 学会一个词是一个缓慢的过程。

ex.en: The process of cleaning a river includes factories upstream, not only the park in the city.
ex.zh: 清理一条河的过程包括上游的工厂，而不只是城里的公园。

col: in the process of｜在……过程中
tip: process 作动词是“加工、处理”，名词重音常在前，动词重音可在后。

senses.en: films, music, and other things people enjoy

ex.en: The entertainment starts after the speeches.
ex.zh: 娱乐节目在讲话之后开始。

ex.en: Free entertainment in the square still needs a toilet and a way home.
ex.zh: 广场上的免费娱乐仍然需要厕所和回家的办法。

tip: entertainment 通常不可数。具体一场节目有时可用 an entertainment。

senses.en: parents and children, or relatives

ex.en: My family has dinner together on Sundays.
ex.zh: 我们家周日一起吃晚饭。

ex.en: When housing is too expensive, a family may spend so much on rent that little remains for books or clinics.
ex.zh: 当住房太贵时，一个家庭可能把太多钱花在房租上，书籍和看病就所剩无几。

tip: family 作整体时谓语用单数；强调家庭成员时有时用复数。

senses.en: to want to know, or to feel surprise
a feeling of surprise, or something wonderful

ex.en: I wonder whether the museum is open.
ex.zh: 我想知道博物馆是否开着。

ex.en: Residents wonder why a new mall was finished before the leaking school roof.
ex.zh: 居民想知道为什么新商场比漏雨的校舍屋顶先完工。

tip: wonder 后常接 if 或 whether。

senses.en: something added, or the process of adding

ex.en: The new lab is a useful addition to the school.
ex.zh: 新实验室是学校有用的增添。

ex.en: In addition to more roads, the town needs pavements if children are to walk safely.
ex.zh: 除了更多的路，如果孩子要安全走路，城镇还需要人行道。

tip: in addition to 后接名词或 doing。

senses.en: to take to a place; to give a speech
to give a speech, lecture, or presentation
to produce the results or benefits that were promised

ex.en: The post office will deliver the package.
ex.zh: 邮局会递送这个包裹。

ex.en: Public transport projects must deliver clear benefits to local residents if they are to justify substantial investment.
ex.zh: 公共交通项目必须为当地居民带来明确的益处，才能证明大规模投资是合理的。

col: deliver on a promise｜兑现承诺
tip: 递送用deliver sth to sb；兑现承诺可用deliver on。

senses.en: to dislike very strongly
a strong dislike

ex.en: I hate waiting in the rain.
ex.zh: 我讨厌在雨里等。

ex.en: People hate a rule they do not understand more than a rule that is strict but clear.
ex.zh: 人们对不理解的规则的反感，超过对严格但清楚的规则。

tip: hate 后接 doing 或 to do。

senses.en: a large group of people in one place
to fill a place

ex.en: A crowd waited at the gate.
ex.zh: 一群人在门口等着。

ex.en: A crowd at a school gate is a design problem if the pavement is too narrow.
ex.zh: 如果人行道太窄，校门口的人群就是一个设计问题。

tip: crowd 作动词是拥挤。crowded 是形容词。

senses.en: a strong wish
to want something strongly

ex.en: Her desire to study medicine is clear.
ex.zh: 她学医的愿望很明确。

ex.en: A desire for a high score should not cancel a night of sleep.
ex.zh: 想得高分的愿望不应当取消一夜睡眠。

tip: desire 比 wish 更强，也更正式。作动词直接接名词或 to do。

senses.en: to rest with the eyes closed
the rest you get at night

ex.en: I sleep for eight hours on school nights.
ex.zh: 上学的晚上我睡八小时。

ex.en: Teenagers sleep better when phones stay out of the bedroom.
ex.zh: 手机不放在卧室时，青少年睡得更好。

tip: sleep 是动词或不可数名词。睡着了用 asleep。

senses.en: a piece of furniture, or a list of figures

ex.en: Please clear the table after lunch.
ex.zh: 午饭后请把桌子收拾干净。

ex.en: A table of bus times is useless if the last bus leaves before school ends.
ex.zh: 如果末班车在放学前离开，一份公交时刻表就没有用。

tip: table 也可指表格。

senses.en: to happen

ex.en: The delay occurred after lunch.
ex.zh: 晚点发生在午饭之后。

ex.en: Floods occur in the same streets when the drain stays blocked.
ex.zh: 排水口一直堵着时，洪水就发生在同样的街道上。

tip: occur 比 happen 正式。It occurred to me that... 表示我想到。

senses.en: to tell someone you are grateful

ex.en: I want to thank you for your help.
ex.zh: 我想谢谢你的帮助。

ex.en: Cities should thank the workers who collect rubbish before dawn, not only the people who design the posters.
ex.zh: 城市应该感谢黎明前收垃圾的工人，而不只是设计海报的人。

tip: thank 是动词，后面接人；名词用 thanks。

senses.en: to become a member, or to connect

ex.en: I want to join the choir.
ex.zh: 我想加入合唱团。

ex.en: A new road that does not join the bus network still leaves many people walking.
ex.zh: 不与公交网络相连的新路，仍然让许多人走路。

tip: join 后接团体表示加入；join in 后接活动。

senses.en: a reduction in price

ex.en: The discount is for students.
ex.zh: 这个折扣是给学生的。

ex.en: A discount that is not written down is not a price a family can check.
ex.zh: 没写下来的折扣，不是家庭能核对的价格。

tip: discount 作动词是打折。

senses.en: to pay to use something, or to employ someone
an act of hiring

ex.en: The school will hire a bus.
ex.zh: 学校将租一辆公交。

ex.en: Do not hire a driver who has already worked a full night.
ex.zh: 不要雇用已经上了一整夜班的司机。

col: hire sb to do｜雇某人做
tip: 英式 hire 可指租用。美式 hire 多指雇用，租用常用 rent。

senses.en: most important
a leader

ex.en: The chief reason for the delay was the rain.
ex.zh: 延误的主要原因是下雨。

ex.en: The chief cost of a new road may be the playground it replaces, not the stone it uses.
ex.zh: 一条新路的主要代价，可能是它取代的操场，而不是它用的石头。

tip: chief 作名词是“首领”。

senses.en: helpful for a purpose

ex.en: The map was useful on the trip.
ex.zh: 这张地图在旅途中很有用。

ex.en: A useful rule is one a new student can follow on the first day.
ex.zh: 有用的规定是新生第一天就能照做的。

tip: 说 sth is useful to sb，或 useful for doing。

senses.en: hopeful, or certain

ex.en: She gave a positive answer.
ex.zh: 她给了肯定的回答。

ex.en: A positive test result should be explained in words a family can understand.
ex.zh: 阳性的检测结果应该用一个家庭能懂的话来解释。

tip: positive 在检测里表示阳性，在态度里表示积极。

senses.en: a short piece of writing
to notice or write down

ex.en: I wrote a note to remind myself.
ex.zh: 我写了张便条提醒自己。

ex.en: A note in the margin of a shared textbook can help the next reader if the handwriting is clear.
ex.zh: 如果字迹清楚，共用课本页边的笔记能帮助下一个读者。

tip: note 作动词是“注意”或“记下”。
